page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor based on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. No local storage or GPU hardware is bundled with this instance type.

Performance benchmarks position this instance primarily in the average tier for multi-core operations and memory bandwidth. The Geekbench multi-core score and Passmark CPU tests fall within the middle 50% of tested servers, supported by a 35 MB L3 cache and hardware instruction sets including AVX-512 and AES. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by bottom-tier results in stress-ng single-core tests, gzip compression, and bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth remains stable, with uncached read speeds reaching 48.91 GB/sec and write speeds at 37.78 GB/sec.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g6.2xlarge offers a standard resource density suitable for workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation without the premium cost of memory-optimized or high-frequency compute instances. Given its balanced resource profile and average multi-core capabilities, it is appropriate for general-purpose workloads such as moderate database operations, text processing, software compilation, and standard web serving.
